ld.name: Absolute Nutrition, Liposomal Vitamin C, 60 Capsules
ld.description: Nutritional Supplements Dietary Supplement The Diet Company® Boost your overall health with Absolute Nutrition's Liposomal Vitamin C 1000 mg capsules. This high potency vitamin C supplement is designed to provide immune support and aid in skin care. Our advanced formula ensures maximum absorption of ascorbic acid, a powerful antioxidant that supports the immune system, promotes cardiovascular function, and enhances brain function. Each capsule contains 1000 mg of pure vitamin C, providing 100% of the daily value needed for adults. Our Liposomal Vitamin C is one of the highest rated vitamin C supplements in the market. It comes in a bio-available form, ensuring that it is easily absorbed by the body for maximum benefits. This makes our vitamin C capsules the best choice for men and women looking for a daily supplement to support their immune defense and improve skin health. The liposomal method of delivery also makes this vitamin C supplement more fat soluble, ensuring that it is absorbed into the bloodstream more efficiently. Made in the USA, our Liposomal Vitamin C 1000 mg is a top-rated choice for immune support and skin care.

paragraphs: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.
